publish: One new song a day at 08:00 IST (02:30 UTC): long video on YouTube and the Reel on Instagram at 08:00, the YouTube Short at 08:05. Made for kids ON, AI content disclosure ON, set the thumbnail by hand if Metricool warns.

songs.title: Here Comes the Garbage Truck!
songs.yt_title: STOMP, LIFT, DUMP! 🚛 Here Comes the Garbage Truck | Recycling Song for Kids | Bro Bros Fun
songs.learn: recycling colours (blue paper, green bottles, yellow cans), helping the community, big and small
songs.why: Working vehicle songs with a shout back chorus keep charting (garbage truck songs in the iTunes kids top 15) and Farmees' vehicle twist beat its plain carols about 7 to 1 this month.
songs.set: town street with three bins (blue, green, yellow), a friendly green garbage truck
songs.suno_style: one clear lead singer, bright youthful vocals, upbeat kids pop, 118 bpm, G major, stomping kick drum, hand claps, brass stabs, truck horn honk sound, xylophone, ukulele, shout back chorus, moderately syncopated groove, half step key lift last chorus
songs.suno_exclude: choir, crowd vocals, gang vocals, children's choir, autotune, heavy distortion
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(clap clap, clap clap clap)
[Spoken] Listen! Beep beep! What's that sound?

[Chorus]
Here comes the garbage truck, beep beep!
Stomp, lift, dump! Stomp, lift, dump!
Here comes the garbage truck, beep beep!
Clean up the town, jump jump jump!

[Verse 1]
Blue bin, blue bin, paper goes in,
Fold it flat and give it a spin!
Green bin, green bin, bottles go clink,
Rinse them out, quick as a wink!

[Chorus]
Here comes the garbage truck, beep beep!
Stomp, lift, dump! Stomp, lift, dump!
Here comes the garbage truck, beep beep!
Clean up the town, jump jump jump!

[Verse 2]
Yellow bin, yellow bin, cans go clang,
Squash them small with a bing bang bang!
Wave to the driver, say thank you!
Helpers help, and we help too!

[Bridge]
Tiptoe, tiptoe, put it in slow...
Now the big arm lifts it, up we go!
Up, up, up... and DUMP!

[Final Chorus]
Here comes the garbage truck, beep beep!
Stomp, lift, dump! Stomp, lift, dump!
Here comes the garbage truck, beep beep!
Clean up the town, jump jump jump!
[Spoken] Thank you, garbage truck! Bye bye!
meshy: a cheerful boy stands in place and stomps his right foot then his left foot to a steady beat, arms swinging, no floor moves
a boy standing in place lifts both arms slowly straight up over his head as if lifting a big box, then drops them down quickly, repeat
a boy standing in place waves one hand high side to side with a big smile, friendly greeting
a boy jumps in place three times with arms raised, landing softly, standing
songs.thumb: Big Bro and Little Bro faces big on the left, the green garbage truck lifting a blue bin on the right, bright blue sky, words: STOMP LIFT DUMP!
songs.short_hook: 0:00 truck horn and Little Bro to camera: 'Beep beep! Stomp with me!' straight into the chorus, loop back to the horn; 35 s
songs.reel_hook: Game cue: 'Which bin? Point!' a bottle flies in, the Bros point green, 3 rounds; 25 s

songs.title: Who Took the Cookie? One for You, One for Me!
songs.yt_title: WHO TOOK THE COOKIE? 🍪 One for You, One for Me | Sharing Song for Kids | Bro Bros Fun
songs.learn: sharing, saying sorry and thank you, counting to four
songs.why: The missing cookie mystery gave our two best Reels; sharing and manners is the most repeated theme in the most viewed kids Shorts ever.
songs.set: cosy kitchen with a cookie jar on the table, Buddy the dog nearby
songs.suno_style: one clear lead singer, bright youthful vocals, playful kids pop with a light swing, 112 bpm, C major, finger snaps, pizzicato strings, glockenspiel, bouncy bass, call and response chorus with short pauses, sneaky tiptoe break
songs.suno_exclude: choir, crowd vocals, gang vocals, children's choir, autotune
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(snap snap, snap snap snap)
[Spoken] Uh oh... the cookie jar is empty!

[Chorus]
Who took the cookie? Who, who, who?
Was it me? Was it you?
One for you and one for me,
Sharing is caring, can't you see!

[Verse 1]
Was it Big Bro? (No, not me!)
Was it Buddy? (Woof! Not me!)
Look! Some crumbs upon the floor,
Tiptoe, tiptoe, find some more!

[Chorus]
Who took the cookie? Who, who, who?
Was it me? Was it you?
One for you and one for me,
Sharing is caring, can't you see!

[Verse 2]
Little Bro has cookie cheeks!
Say sorry, say it sweet!
Break it up, one, two, three, four,
Now there's cookies for everyone, and more!

[Bridge]
Shh... tiptoe... (stop!)
Peek... look... (there!)
Found it! Let's share!

[Final Chorus]
Who took the cookie? Who, who, who?
Now it's me AND it's you!
One for you and one for me,
Sharing is caring, can't you see!
[Spoken] Thank you! Yummy!
meshy: a boy standing in place shrugs both shoulders up with palms open, shaking his head no, playful
a boy tiptoes in place slowly lifting knees high, one finger on his lips, sneaky
a boy standing in place points forward at the camera with one hand then points to himself
a boy standing in place rubs his tummy in circles and nods happily
songs.thumb: Little Bro with puffed cookie cheeks and crumbs, Big Bro pointing at him laughing, a big cookie in front, warm orange background, words: WHO TOOK IT?
songs.short_hook: 0:00 empty jar close up, Big Bro gasps 'Who took the cookie?' and points at the camera; cut ends on the same jar so it loops; 30 s
songs.reel_hook: 'Guess who! Comment the name!' three suspects in a row, reveal on the beat; 20 s

songs.title: Red Light, Green Light, Cross With Me!
songs.yt_title: STOP, LOOK, HOLD HANDS! 🚦 Red Light Green Light | Road Safety Song for Kids | Bro Bros Fun
songs.learn: traffic light colours, stop look listen, holding a grown up's hand at the road
songs.why: Our 20 Nov traffic light Reel drew 25 shares from 44 people, our first real sharing; the safety song topic is a top hit for Cocobi.
songs.set: bright town crossing with a zebra crossing and a big smiling traffic light
songs.suno_style: one clear lead singer, bright youthful vocals, cheerful marching kids song, 110 bpm, F major, snare march, toy trumpet, xylophone, beep sounds, freeze stops on 'red light', moderately syncopated
songs.suno_exclude: choir, crowd vocals, gang vocals, children's choir, car crash sounds, sirens
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(drum drum, drum drum drum)
[Spoken] Ready, Little Bro? Let's cross the road the safe way!

[Chorus]
Red light, red light, STOP! (freeze)
Yellow light, yellow light, wait right there,
Green light, green light, hold my hand,
Cross with me, we cross with care!

[Verse 1]
Stop at the kerb, toes behind the line,
Look to the left, look right, one more time,
Listen, listen, what can you hear?
Wait till the road is clear, clear, clear!

[Chorus]
Red light, red light, STOP! (freeze)
Yellow light, yellow light, wait right there,
Green light, green light, hold my hand,
Cross with me, we cross with care!

[Verse 2]
Walk, don't run, on the stripy stripes,
Black and white like a zebra's stripes!
Hold a grown up's hand so tight,
Now we're safe, that's right, that's right!

[Bridge]
Red! (stop) Yellow! (wait) Green! (go)
Faster: Red! Yellow! Green!

[Final Chorus]
Red light, red light, STOP! (freeze)
Yellow light, yellow light, wait right there,
Green light, green light, hold my hand,
Cross with me, we cross with care!
meshy: a boy marching in place with knees up, then suddenly freezing still with arms out straight
a boy standing in place turns his head and upper body to the left, then to the right, hand over his eyes like looking
a boy standing in place cups one hand behind his ear, listening, then nods
a boy walks in place slowly with small careful steps, one arm reaching out to the side as if holding a hand
songs.thumb: Big Bro holding Little Bro's hand, a giant friendly traffic light glowing red, plain bright blue background, words: STOP! LOOK!
songs.short_hook: 0:00 'RED LIGHT... FREEZE!' both Bros freeze mid march, then green and they dance; ends on the next red so it loops; 30 s
songs.reel_hook: Freeze game: 'Can you freeze when it turns red?' three rounds, faster each time; 25 s

songs.title: Brave at the Doctor! One, Two, Three, Sticker!
songs.yt_title: ONE, TWO, THREE... STICKER! 🩺 Brave at the Doctor | Check Up Song for Kids | Bro Bros Fun
songs.learn: what happens at a check up, body parts, being brave and taking a deep breath
songs.why: A doctor shot song is Joy Joy World's most viewed video (about 580M); the check up timestamps Short format is rising. Gentle, no pain, no crying.
songs.set: bright friendly clinic with a height chart, a teddy bear on the bed, sticker sheet
songs.suno_style: one clear lead singer, bright youthful vocals, warm reassuring kids pop, 108 bpm, C major, soft claps, ukulele, marimba, gentle synth pad, big happy sticker moment with a bell chime, deep breath pause
songs.suno_exclude: choir, crowd vocals, gang vocals, children's choir, crying sounds, scary sounds
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(clap clap, clap clap clap)
[Spoken] Hi doctor! I'm a little bit nervous... but I'm brave!

[Chorus]
One, two, three, STICKER!
Brave, brave, brave like me!
Take a big breath in... and out,
I'm brave, I'm brave, without a doubt!

[Verse 1]
Stand up tall, how big am I?
Taller than last time, oh my my!
Open wide and say 'Aaah'!
The doctor says 'Wow, there you are!'

[Chorus]
One, two, three, STICKER!
Brave, brave, brave like me!
Take a big breath in... and out,
I'm brave, I'm brave, without a doubt!

[Verse 2]
Boom boom, boom boom, hear my heart,
Listening tube, that's the fun part!
Tap tap knees, my leg goes kick!
All done now, that was quick!

[Bridge]
Smell the flower... (breathe in)
Blow the candle... (breathe out)
One more time... in... and out!

[Final Chorus]
One, two, three, STICKER!
Brave, brave, brave like me!
Take a big breath in... and out,
I'm brave, I'm brave, without a doubt!
[Spoken] Look! A star sticker! High five!

a boy standing in place breathes in slowly raising both arms out to the sides, then breathes out lowering them
a boy standing in place pats his chest twice with one hand to a heartbeat rhythm, smiling
a boy standing in place gives a big high five with one hand, then cheers with both fists up

songs.title: Freeze, Then Jingle! Christmas Freeze Dance
songs.yt_title: FREEZE... THEN JINGLE! 🎄 Christmas Freeze Dance | Jingle Bells Dance Song for Kids | Bro Bros Fun
songs.learn: listening and stopping (self control), counting down, fast and slow
songs.why: Strongest song of the week for Friday: freeze games are our best Reel hook and the Jingle Bells funk freeze is the top TikTok dance of late November. Jingle Bells (1857) is public domain; our own funk arrangement and new verses. Also post the weekly compilation today.
songs.set: snowy town square with a big Christmas tree and twinkling lights, snow falling gently
songs.suno_style: one clear lead singer, bright youthful vocals, funky Christmas kids dance song, 116 bpm, G major, sleigh bells, slap bass funk groove, brass hits, hand claps, sudden full stops for freeze, swing shuffle, half step key lift last chorus
songs.suno_exclude: choir, crowd vocals, gang vocals, children's choir, autotune
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(sleigh bells, clap clap clap)
[Spoken] When the music stops... you FREEZE! Ready?

[Chorus]
Jingle, jingle, wiggle and shake,
Dance like a jolly snowflake!
Jingle, jingle, all the way...
FREEZE! (stop) ...Now jingle away!

[Verse 1]
Shake your hands up high, high, high,
Reach up to the starry sky,
Stomp your boots, stomp, stomp, stomp...
FREEZE! (stop) ...Now jump, jump, jump!

[Chorus]
Jingle, jingle, wiggle and shake,
Dance like a jolly snowflake!
Jingle, jingle, all the way...
FREEZE! (stop) ...Now jingle away!

[Verse 2]
Tap your chest, boom boom boom,
Spin your arms around the room,
Slow like a snowman... slooow...
FREEZE! (stop) ...Now go, go, go!

[Bridge]
Faster! Faster! Jingle quick!
FREEZE! (stop)
Slower... slower... tick... tock... tick...
FREEZE! (stop)

[Final Chorus]
Jingle, jingle, wiggle and shake,
Dance like a jolly snowflake!
Jingle, jingle, all the way...
FREEZE! (stop) ...Merry Christmas, hooray!

songs.title: Dear Santa, I'm THIS Tall!
songs.yt_title: DEAR SANTA, I'M THIS TALL! 🎅 Kind Wish Christmas Song for Kids | Bro Bros Fun
songs.learn: measuring and growing, being kind, writing a letter, numbers on a height chart
songs.why: Later's 20 Nov Reels pick is 'Dear Santa, I'm a size...' and Christmas wishlist videos pass 90M views; we turn it into a kindness wish, no toy brands.
songs.set: living room by the fireplace with a height chart on the door frame, crayons, a letter and a mailbox
songs.suno_style: one clear lead singer, bright youthful vocals, warm Christmas kids pop, 112 bpm, C major, sleigh bells, celesta, acoustic piano, soft claps, light swing, big friendly chorus carried by drums and bells
songs.suno_exclude: choir, crowd vocals, gang vocals, children's choir, autotune
songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(bells, clap clap clap)
[Spoken] Big Bro, mark my height! I'm writing to Santa!

[Chorus]
Dear Santa, I'm THIS tall! (stretch up!)
I've grown so big since last fall!
I was kind, I shared my ball,
Dear Santa, I'm THIS tall!

[Verse 1]
Stand up straight against the door,
Mark the line, one inch more!
Get my crayons, red and green,
The nicest letter you've ever seen!

[Chorus]
Dear Santa, I'm THIS tall! (stretch up!)
I've grown so big since last fall!
I was kind, I shared my ball,
Dear Santa, I'm THIS tall!

[Verse 2]
I helped my friend when she fell down,
I made my grandma smile, not frown,
My wish is snow for everyone,
And hugs and games and Christmas fun!

[Bridge]
Fold it up... (fold, fold)
Pop it in... (pop!)
Off it flies to the North Pole... whoosh!

[Final Chorus]
Dear Santa, we're THIS tall! (stretch up!)
We've grown so big since last fall!
We were kind to one and all,
Dear Santa, we're THIS tall!

songs.yt_title: Snowflake, Float Down Slow ❄️ Gentle Winter Bedtime Song for Kids | Bro Bros Fun
songs.learn: slow and gentle movement, calming breaths, saying good night, counting snowflakes to five
songs.why: The playbook asks for one slow 60 to 70 BPM wind down song a week; Sunday evening is family bedtime, and winter snow travels to every market.

songs.lyrics:
[Intro]
(music box)
[Spoken, whisper] Shh... look outside... it's snowing.

[Chorus]
Snowflake, snowflake, float down slow,
Soft and quiet, soft as snow,
La la la, la la loo,
Snowflake, I see you.

[Verse 1]
One little snowflake, two, three, four,
Five on the window, by the door,
Sway like a snowflake, side to side,
Arms out wide, arms out wide.

[Chorus]
Snowflake, snowflake, float down slow,
Soft and quiet, soft as snow,
La la la, la la loo,
Snowflake, I see you.

[Verse 2]
Breathe in the cold air, slow and deep,
Blow it out softly, time to sleep,
Good night, garden, good night, tree,
Good night, snowflake, good night, me.

[Outro]
La la la, la la loo...
Good night... sleep tight... (whisper) good night.
